title: Investment Analysts’ Price Target Changes for August, 15th (AAPL, CASA, CEC1, DEQ, DRW3, EVD, G, HHFA, LEO, NFLX)
text:
Tweet
Investment Analysts’ price target changes for Wednesday, August 15th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $214.00 price target by analysts at Macquarie. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Casa Systems (NASDAQ:CASA) had its target price cut by Loop Capital to $12.00. The firm currently has a positive rating on the stock. Ceconomy AG Preference Shares (ETR:CEC1) was given a €7.00 ($7.95) price target by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Deutsche EuroShop (ETR:DEQ) was given a €39.00 ($44.32) target price by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Draegerwerk AG & Co KGaA Preference Shares (ETR:DRW3) was given a €55.00 ($62.50) price target by analysts at Hauck & Aufhaeuser. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
CTS Eventim AG & Co KGaA (ETR:EVD) was given a €49.00 ($55.68) target price by analysts at Hauck & Aufhaeuser. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Assicurazioni Generali (BIT:G) was given a €19.80 ($22.50) target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Hamburger Hafen und Logistik (ETR:HHFA) was given a €19.30 ($21.93) target price by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Leoni (ETR:LEO) was given a €55.00 ($62.50) target price by analysts at Nord/LB. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Netflix (NASDAQ:NFLX) was given a $388.00 price target by analysts at Macquarie. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
PetIQ (NASDAQ:PETQ) had its target price increased by SunTrust Banks, Inc. to $40.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Symrise (FRA:SY1) was given a €73.00 ($82.95) target price by analysts at Nord/LB. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Tapestry (NYSE:TPR) had its target price boosted by Royal Bank of Canada to $58.00. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Vipshop (NYSE:VIPS) had its price target reduced by Benchmark Co. to $12.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Siltronic (FRA:WAF) was given a €190.00 ($215.91) price target by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Exxon Mobil (NYSE:XOM) was given a $87.00 price target by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
